title: Hub Lombardini22
description: A showcase website for Hub Lombardini22, the innovation and knowledge hub of one of Italy's leading architecture and engineering firms. The site features physics-based interactive animations powered by Matter.js, content managed via a headless Strapi CMS, and a clean editorial design that reflects the firm's design philosophy.
highlights: Built a physics-based particle animation on the hero using Matter.js
Integrated a Strapi headless CMS so the editorial team can publish content independently
Implemented smooth scroll-driven section transitions for an immersive reading experience
Delivered a fully responsive layout optimised for both desktop deep-dives and mobile browsing
